method.name: RetypeShared
method.brief: Allocate zeroed frames that a hypervisor or DMA device can access.
method.description: Allocates contiguous frames from the source RAM untyped using its normal watermark. Each frame has a separate capability. Stop DMA before deleting its last capability or revoking the source. Final deletion restores private, zeroed RAM. SEL4_BOOTINFO_HEADER_SHARED_DMA indicates that DMA requires shared frames.

error.name: seL4_InvalidCapability
error.description: The source does not designate shareable RAM.

error.name: seL4_InvalidArgument
error.description: The requested frame size is unsupported.

error.name: seL4_TruncatedMessage
error.description: A required argument or destination root is missing.

error.name: seL4_RangeError
error.description: The destination window is invalid or the request exceeds 256 frames or 2 MiB.

error.name: seL4_NotEnoughMemory
error.description: The aligned frames do not fit in the remaining RAM.

error.name: seL4_FailedLookup
error.description: The destination CNode could not be resolved.

interface.name: seL4_X64_PML4
interface.cap_description: Capability to the VSpace root (PML4) being operated on.

method.name: FrameBatch
method.brief: Copy-and-map, remap or delete frame capabilities in this address space, many in one call.
method.description: The header (message word 0) is op (bits 0-1: 1 copy-and-map, 2 remap, 3 delete), the number of entries (bits 8-15), the depth of every CPtr (bits 16-22, 1 to 64), the seL4_CapRights mask the mappings get (bits 24-27), the seL4_CapRights mask a copy keeps (bits 28-31), the VM attributes, seL4_X86_DeferFlush included (bits 32-36), and the flag that defers the TLB invalidation of deletes (bit 40); the other bits are reserved (zero). The entries follow, all of the header's op. Copy-and-map, three words (source CPtr, destination CPtr, vaddr): copy the frame capability, masked with the copy rights, into the empty destination slot and map it at vaddr; a failure leaves neither. Remap, two words (CPtr, vaddr): map the frame capability, which is unmapped or already maps vaddr in this address space. Delete, one word (CPtr): delete the frame capability; an empty slot is no error. With the defer flag, a deleted frame mapped in this address space (other than a device frame) is unmapped without its own invalidation, and the call invalidates the address space once, before it returns. Extra capability 0 is the CNode the CPtrs are looked up in; extra capability 1, if given, is the destination CNode of copies. The entries run in order and the call stops at the first that fails; a Call's reply is (entries done, the seL4_Error of the failing entry or 0).

param.name: header
param.description: Op, count, depth, rights, attributes and flags
